assumptions.description: Fixed input order; the entire data sequence is chosen before play begins.

description_paragraphs: Entries of $A$ lie in the public finite alphabet $\{0,\pm1,\pm1/\sqrt q\}$ with public encoding of integer $q\ge1$. The row sequence is fixed in advance. Assume $m,n\ge1$, $1\le k<\min\{m,n\}$, and $\varepsilon>0$.
source_fields.description_zh: Entries of $A$ lie in the public finite alphabet $\{0,\pm1,\pm1/\sqrt q\}$ with public encoding of integer $q\ge1$. The row sequence is fixed in advance. Assume $m,n\ge1$, $1\le k<\min\{m,n\}$, and $\varepsilon>0$.
source_fields.instance: The matrix $A\in\mathbb R^{m\times n}$ arrives by rows in a public finite encoding. The source hard-instance alphabet $\{0,\pm1,\pm1/\sqrt q\}$ is allowed, with public $q$. The entire input and row order are fixed in advance.
source_fields.parameter_domain_description: Require m,n ≥ 1, 1 ≤ k < min(m,n), ε > 0, and one pass. Low input rank is not assumed.

description_paragraphs: Let $A_k$ be any best rank-$k$ Frobenius approximation. Success requires $\|A(I_n-P)\|_{\mathrm{F}}^2\le(1+\varepsilon)\|A-A_k\|_{\mathrm{F}}^2$; the residual is explicitly squared. When the optimal residual is zero, the row space must be recovered exactly.
source_fields.description_zh: Let $A_k$ be any best rank-$k$ Frobenius approximation. Success requires $\|A(I_n-P)\|_{\mathrm F}^2\le(1+\varepsilon)\|A-A_k\|_{\mathrm F}^2$; the residual is explicitly squared. When the optimal residual is zero, the row space must be recovered exactly.
source_fields.finiteness_conditions: The specified dimension is finite, and the model and spectral assumptions hold.
source_fields.normalization: If both numerator and denominator are zero, the loss is zero. A zero denominator with nonzero numerator gives +∞. Otherwise use the stated ratio.

description_paragraphs: The information $m,n,k,\varepsilon$ and encoding parameter $q$ are public. A call reveals only the next complete row. Consumed rows are unavailable; after the stream, the algorithm cannot query $Av$ or reread the input.
source_fields.description_zh: The information $m,n,k,\varepsilon$ and encoding parameter $q$ are public. A call reveals only the next complete row. Consumed rows are unavailable; after the stream, the algorithm cannot query $Av$ or reread the input.

operations.access_schedule: one pass, fixed row order, no past requery
operations.coupling: The complete input and row order are fixed before the private seed is drawn. Future data do not adapt to algorithm state.

feedback_quality.description: Exact elements with a public finite symbolic encoding

operations.index_control: Rows cannot be selected, reordered, or revisited; only the stored state can be updated.
operations.order_convention: Native matrix access; no scalar derivative order is assigned.
operations.query_signature: Receive arrival i in the fixed order; the algorithm does not submit a numerical query vector.
operations.response_signature: The full current row a_iᵀ contains n exact input entries. It arrives once and cannot be reread.

public_inputs: The finite-alphabet encoding rule and q are public; the encoded entries are hidden.
source_fields.query_domain_description: There is no selectable query vector. The next row is received passively, with no Av or Aᵀu channel.

source_fields.allowed_postprocessing: Decode the output only from the final state and public parameters. Do not reread the input or recover discarded rows from an output medium.
source_fields.certificate_requirement: Only the true-loss guarantee is required; no computable certificate is requested.
description_paragraphs: After the stream, use only retained state to output $P=P^{\mathsf T}=P^2\in\mathbb{R}^{n\times n}$ with $\operatorname{rank}(P)=k$; an orthonormal-basis representation is allowed. Returning $AP$ is unnecessary.
source_fields.description_zh: After the stream ends, use only the retained final state to output $P=P^{\mathsf T}=P^2\in\mathbb R^{n\times n}$ and $\operatorname{rank}(P)=k$. An orthonormal-basis representation is acceptable. Outputting $AP$ is not required.
source_fields.feasibility: Return a basis or finite description of a right rank-$k$ subspace, defining a rank-$k$ orthogonal projection $P\in\mathbb R^{n\times n}$. The product $AP$ need not be output.

source_fields.budget_semantics: One pass; peak memory is bounded for every input and random seed.
description_paragraphs: The native resource is peak simultaneous memory in bits, $S_{\mathrm{bit}}$. One pass is a fixed protocol requirement and is not added to bit memory. Input encoding, working state, and output-encoding requirements must be retained.
The cost limit holds for every input and private seed. The final output must be decoded from the charged state, without an unregistered external cache.
source_fields.description_zh:
The resource is the maximum number $S_{\mathrm{bit}}$ of simultaneously retained bits. A single pass is a fixed protocol and is not added to bit memory. Preserve the input encoding, working-state, and output-encoding requirements.

The cap holds for every input and random seed. The final output must be decoded from charged state, without undeclared external storage.
source_fields.online_cost: One pass, with input rows arriving sequentially
source_fields.precision_model: Inputs have exact finite-symbol encoding and persistent state is finite-bit; word width is not free. The source hard instance does not supply a general rounding algorithm, a finite-bit Frequent Directions upper bound, or a uniform output word length.
source_fields.scalarization: Record passes = 1, peak memory_bits, and stream_rows = m separately. Do not convert them to real-register counts.
source_fields.setup_cost: An external stream supplies rows sequentially. All information retained across rows counts as working state, and the output is decoded only from the final state.

description_paragraphs: After one pass over the rows of $A\in\mathbb{R}^{m\times n}$, return a rank-$k$ orthogonal right projection.
source_fields.description_zh: After one pass over the rows of $A\in\mathbb R^{m\times n}$, return a right orthogonal projection of rank $k$.

algorithms.adaptivity: The state may depend on past inputs; the input order cannot be chosen.
description_paragraphs: Randomized computable one-pass streaming algorithms are allowed. The retained state is a finite bit string, including random-generator state under the declared memory model. No span or running-time restriction is added beyond one pass and bit memory.
algorithms.description_zh: Randomized computable one-pass streaming algorithms are allowed. The retained state is a finite bit string, including random-generator state under the declared memory model. No span or running-time restriction is added beyond one pass and bit memory.
algorithms.internal_computation: The state between rows is a finite bit string, with randomized computable transitions. A public rule decodes the final output from that state. The output may be a symbolic subspace description; coordinatewise finite-decimal orthogonalization is not required.
algorithms.parallelism: Sequential row arrivals, with no free parallel copies.

guarantees.complete_expression: For every row stream fixed in advance and admitting finite encoding, the squared residual is at most $(1+\epsilon)\mathrm{OPT}_{\mathrm{squared}}$ with probability at least $2/3$. If the optimum is zero, exact residual zero is required.
description_paragraphs: The algorithm is selected using only public inputs. For every admissible input fixed before its private seed is generated, the success event has probability at least $2/3$ over that private randomness.
guarantees.description_zh: The algorithm is selected using only public inputs. For every admissible input fixed before its private seed is generated, the success event has probability at least $2/3$ over that private randomness.
guarantees.quantifier_order: exists algorithm; for every fixed input; Pr_seed(success)>=2/3
